content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the MGU Assistant Professor positions is 15th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University is as per the norms set by the University Grants Commission (UGC). Candidates should refer to the official notification for specific details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University has announced a total of 24 vacancies for the Assistant Professor positions across various schools and departments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor positions is 70 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for MGU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process involves sending your application via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for MGU Assistant Professor jobs?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) applying for the Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor positions at Mahatma Gandhi University will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Which departments have vacancies for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in various departments including School of Biosciences, School of Pure and Applied Physics, School of Physical Education and Sports Sciences, School of Letters, School of Computer Sciences, and many others listed in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for MGU recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for MGU recruitment can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
